name: v1.5.1
body:
## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Base Mainnet**: Operators must upgrade to this release by November 5 at 18:00:00 UTC for the Denim hardfork. See [here](https://docs.base.org/upgrades/denim/overview) for more information.
> **Base Sepolia**: Denim is already active on Base Sepolia, so there is no new activation in this release. Upgrading is recommended for the peer discovery fix and transaction pool performance improvements.
>
> The default batcher throttle thresholds have changed, and the DA backlog is now measured in estimated compressed bytes: `--throttle-start-threshold` from 1,000,000 to 120,000,000 and `--throttle-full-threshold` from 2,000,000 to 360,000,000. Batcher operators who set these flags explicitly should recalibrate them for the new unit.

### base-reth-node
- Denim support on Base Mainnet, activating November 5 at 18:00:00 UTC
- Faster transaction pool: forwarded transaction batches are validated together against one state provider, sequential lanes are invalidated lazily, and validity conditions are partitioned after ingestion
- New opt-in `--tx-forwarding-batched-insert` flag inserts forwarded transaction batches in one builder call (builders and sequencers must be upgraded before mempool nodes enable it)
- Bug fixes and improvements

### base-consensus
- Denim support on Base Mainnet, activating November 5 at 18:00:00 UTC
- Peers behind NAT can now join the discovery table
- Bug fixes and improvements

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/base/base/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

name: v1.5.0
body:
## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Base Mainnet**: This release is safe for mainnet node operators to upgrade to. Denim is only scheduled on Base Sepolia, so mainnet behavior is unchanged. The mainnet Denim activation will come in a future release.
> **Base Sepolia**: Operators must upgrade to this release by October 21 at 18:00:00 UTC for the Denim hardfork. See [here](https://docs.base.org/upgrades/denim/overview) for more information.
>
> `--enable-experimental-validity-transactions` has been removed as a CLI flag for `base-reth-node`. Validity transactions are enabled by default now that Cobalt is live on every network. Operators must remove the flag from their entrypoint command if it is present, or the node will fail to start.
>
> The default proofs history window (`--proofs-history.window`) has changed from 1,296,000 blocks (about 1 month at 2s blocks) to 6,480,000 blocks (about 15 days at 200ms blocks). Operators who rely on the default and need a different retention period should set the flag explicitly.

### base-reth-node
- Denim support (Base Sepolia only)
- Validity transactions are always on, and the experimental flag is removed
- jemalloc is now the default global allocator, and `asm-keccak` and `keccak-cache-global` are enabled by default
- Faster proof generation: parallel witness multiproof prewarming, exact point lookups for proofs state reads, and reuse of RocksDB iterators
- Faster proofs snapshot downloads: parallel resumable range streams, extraction during download, and manifest checksum verification
- Bug fixes and improvements

### base-consensus
- Denim support (Base Sepolia only), including a maximum sequencer drift of 6 hours from Denim onward
- RPC methods that the consensus node does not serve are now forwarded to the execution client
- Bug fixes and improvements

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/base/base/compare/v1.4.2...v1.5.0

name: v1.4.2
body:
## Latest Release

> [!IMPORTANT]
> This release replaces **v1.4.1**, and operators must upgrade to v1.4.2.

## What Changed

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Base Mainnet**: Operators must upgrade to this release by September 30 at 18:00:00 UTC for the Cobalt hardfork. See [here](https://docs.base.org/upgrades/cobalt/overview) for more information.
> 
> Similar to v1.4.0, `--rollup.disable-tx-pool-gossip` has been deprecated as a CLI flag for `base-reth-node`. Operators are required to simply remove it from their entrypoint command if you have it present (only relevant if you're upgrading directly from <= v1.3.x)
>
> If you run a node capable of serving proofs requests, this release now includes support for downloading Proofs v2 snapshots. See [here](https://chain.base.org/snapshots) for the preset. 

### base-reth-node
- Cobalt support for mainnet
- Proofs v2 snapshots support for all networks
- Bug fixes and improvements

### base-consensus
- Cobalt support for mainnet
- Bug fixes and improvements

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/base/base/compare/v1.4.1...v1.4.2
